flows.title: Add a collaborator to an app
steps: Select the app in the dashboard and click the Access tab.
In the New collaborator window, type the person's email address.
Click Save changes. Heroku emails them that they were granted access to the app, or sends an invitation if no Heroku account matches the address.

flows.title: Remove a collaborator from an app
steps: Select the app in the dashboard and click the Access tab.
Click the x beside the collaborator's email address.
